name: rxlocal-mcp
description: RxLocal (PioneerRx/RedSail) pharmacy patient-portal MCP — prescriptions, refill options, pharmacy messages, and confirm-gated refill requests and messages

rxlocal_disable_fetchproxy.title: Disable browser bridge (advanced)
rxlocal_disable_fetchproxy.description: Set to 1/true to refuse to read the signed-in tab via the fetchproxy bridge (CI / headless). Every tool then fails instead of reading a session. Defaults to false.

fetchproxy_ws_port.title: fetchproxy port (advanced)
fetchproxy_ws_port.description: Localhost port of the fetchproxy concentrator the ContextMint Bridge extension connects to (default 37149). Every MCP on one machine shares it, so move it for all of them or not at all.

fetchproxy_ws_host.title: fetchproxy bind address (advanced)
fetchproxy_ws_host.description: Bind interface for the fetchproxy concentrator, a literal IP only (default 127.0.0.1). Keep on loopback; it exists for hosted deployments that run each MCP in its own network namespace.

fetchproxy_identity_dir.title: fetchproxy identity directory (advanced)
fetchproxy_identity_dir.description: Absolute path where the fetchproxy long-term identity keypair is stored (default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/).

tools.name: rxlocal_profile
tools.description: Account holder's profile: name, email, phone, account type, patient + user IDs

tools.name: rxlocal_age_gate
tools.description: Account-holder age gate (under-minimum flag + minimum age)

tools.name: rxlocal_notifications
tools.description: Most-relevant notification banner for the account

tools.name: rxlocal_legal
tools.description: Terms of Use or Privacy Policy document

tools.name: rxlocal_list_prescriptions
tools.description: Prescriptions on file: drug, Rx number, refills remaining, days supply, expiration, prescriber, and whether a refill can be requested

tools.name: rxlocal_get_refill_options
tools.description: Pickup/delivery/mail options, pickup times and calendar, pharmacy hours, and the pharmacy's refill disclaimers

tools.name: rxlocal_list_messages
tools.description: Recent secure messages with the pharmacy (never marks them read)

tools.name: rxlocal_request_refill
tools.description: Request refills/renewals of one or more prescriptions (confirm-gated write)

tools.name: rxlocal_send_message
tools.description: Send a plain-text secure message to the pharmacy (confirm-gated write)

tools.name: rxlocal_healthcheck
tools.description: Verify the RxLocal session and API reachability: reads the signed-in tab, makes one authenticated call, and distinguishes "no session" from "session rejected" from "bridge down".
